title: SkillChain: Closing the Loop on Skill Evolution for Image-Based E-Commerce AI Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2606.12984v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Image-based AI assistants are now deployed at production scale on e-commerce platforms, where a single uploaded image can trigger fundamentally different user intents: product search, style recommendation, visual encyclopedia, or utility tool calls, each demanding its own response format, tool invocation, and domain knowledge. Without per-intent behavioral constraints, LLM-based systems conflate these heterogeneous modes and fall short of domain quality standards, while the breadth and dynamism of the intent space render manual engineering infeasible. To address this, we present SkillChain, which closes the production feedback loop on Skill evolution, automating the lifecycle of Skills through three stages: Skill Creator for bootstrapping from task specs and trajectories, Route Optimizer for routing alignment, and Body Refiner for iterative Skill Body refinement via dual-path LLM-Judge evaluation. Deployed on a production-scale e-com

translated_title: SkillChain：为基于图像的电商AI助手闭环技能演化
translated_abstract: 基于图像的AI助手现已在大规模电商平台上投入生产，其中单张上传图像可能触发根本不同的用户意图：产品搜索、风格推荐、视觉百科或实用工具调用，每种意图都需要各自的响应格式、工具调用和领域知识。如果没有针对意图的行为约束，基于LLM的系统会混淆这些异构模式，达不到领域质量标准，而意图空间的广度和动态性使手动工程不可行。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SkillChain，它闭环了技能演化的生产反馈回路，通过三个阶段自动化技能生命周期：用于从任务规范和轨迹启动的Skill Creator、用于路由对齐的Route Optimizer，以及通过双路径LLM-Judge评估进行迭代技能体细化的Body Refiner。该系统已部署在大规模电商平台上。
tldr: SkillChain通过自动化技能创建、路由优化和迭代细化，为基于图像的电商AI助手实现了技能演化的生产闭环，有效应对异构用户意图的挑战。
en_tdlr: SkillChain closes the production feedback loop on skill evolution for image-based e-commerce AI assistants by automating skill creation, route optimization, and iterative refinement, effectively addressing heterogeneous user intents.
